summary.text: Shannon Erickson is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 124, having assumed office in 2006, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as president and CEO of Lowcountry Building Blocks, Inc., and notes that the Republican primary for her seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Erickson earned a B.A. from the University of South Carolina Beaufort in 1997 and attended classes at Francis Marion University.
Her professional experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes serving as a state representative and as President and CEO of Lowcountry Building Blocks, Inc.

She has been affiliated with organizations including Beaufort AMI Kids, the Beaufort Regional Chamber of Commerce, the Lady's Island Business & Professional Association, the Junior Service League, Hopeful Horizons and St. Peter's Catholic Church.
Erickson chaired the House Education and Public Works Committee in the 2023-2024 session and is assigned to that committee in the 2025-2026 session.
Earlier in her tenure she served on the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee, the Ways and Means Committee, and the Regulations and Administrative Procedures Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Shauna Bishop, a Democrat, as her general-election opponent.
